# Mold Solutionz 24/7

> Got mold? We have the solution.

Mold Solutionz 24/7 (Mold Solutionz 24/7 LLC) is a professional restoration contractor serving Cerritos, CA and surrounding areas since 2017. We provide 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, and reconstruction services. Phone: (714) 409-4758 · Email: moldsolutionz247@gmail.com.
